rationale: CanvasWidget gains keyed cached groups for the Canvas2D shim's ctx.pulpCachedGroup: begin_group/end_group record commands into a group stored beside the frame's command stream, replay_group appends a replay_group command by reference, and invalidate_group/invalidate_all_groups drop them. The retained-ui-kernel touch is confined to canvas_widget.hpp and canvas_widget.cpp: paint() walks a stream that contains group replays through replay_sequence(), which expands each replay in place inside an implicit save/restore, drops a restore that would pop state saved outside the group, and closes saves the group leaves open. A stream with no group replays is walked exactly as before, so existing command streams paint unchanged; the new replay_group command type is appended to the enum. Cached groups are a Pulp extension to its own Canvas2D command replay with no counterpart framework behavior to backport, so this is recorded pulp-only.
